title: Experts disagree on src/hud/last-block.ts takeAllowedOnce
context:
Chief architect: single consumption is the security invariant; the qa race concern is answered by the exact tool_use_id match (only the one retried call can match), and the plan should still add a parallel-read test so the race is proven harmless rather than assumed

Target: src/hud/last-block.ts takeAllowedOnce
- security-auditor: an allowed_once mark is consumed on the first gate read that matches, so a second identical call, or a replay of the same retry, is denied again
- qa-engineer: takeAllowedOnce reads then rewrites the record without a lock, so two parallel subagent PreToolUse runs on the same session can both read allowed_once true; the test plan needs a case proving at most one call is asked, or the spec must state that the tool_use_id match makes the race harmless
